entities.summary: Peter Brabeck-Letmathe is an Austrian businessman. From 1997 to 2008 he was the CEO of the Nestlé Group, chairman 2005-2017 and then chairman emeritus until April 2026. He is a former chairman of the Formula One Group. and served for a short time as ad interim chairman of the World Economic Forum in 2025.
